name: Pipeliners - Repipe Wording Check 2026-10-01
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-10-01

# Summary
A read-only check from Oct 1, 2026, the day Scott confirmed Pipeliners does not do full repipes. The script lists every sentence mentioning repiping in posts 13742 (/5-signs-you-need-to-repipe-your-home-in-arizona/) and 13682 (the repiping vs relining post), with word counts. Before copies of the /sun-city/ and /tolleson/ pages were saved.

# Key findings
- Later notes record the outcome as a standing rule: existing repipe wording stays as it is and no new repipe claims are added (the "repipe wording rule"). Tolleson was held pending repipe wording.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `rp.php` (read-only listing script), `sun-city.before.html`, `tolleson.before.html`.
